notes.title: Myth of Lumi — macOS Version Now Live (Known Issue on Apple Silicon)
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to share that [b]Myth of Lumi is now available on macOS[/b]. Thank you for your patience and support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Important Compatibility Notice (Apple Silicon)[/b][/p][p]We’ve identified a rendering issue on some [b]Apple Silicon (M-series) Macs[/b] where [b]certain in-game UI elements may not display[/b]. We’re sorry for the inconvenience this may cause. Our team will be investigating and working toward a fix, and we’ll share progress through upcoming patch notes and announcements.[/p][list][*][p][b]Affected:[/b] macOS on [b]Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Not affected:[/b] macOS on [b]Intel[/b] chips (UI rendering should behave normally)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]How You Can Help[/b][/p][p]If you encounter the issue, please let us know in the [b]Steam Discussions[/b] with:[/p][olist][*][p]Your [b]Mac model[/b], [b]chip[/b], [b]RAM[/b], and [b]macOS version[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Your [b]in-game graphics settings[/b] (resolution, window mode, post-processing, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]screenshot or short video[/b] of the problem[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steps to reproduce[/b] (what you were doing when it occurred)[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate your understanding and reports—they help us resolve this faster.
Enjoy your journey in Myth of Lumi![/p][p][/p][p]— The Myth of Lumi Dev Team[/p]
